prompt: I'm about to commit my changes to the travel recommendation system. Before I commit, I need to make sure all tests pass and see a coverage report.

assertions.name: test_count_shown
assertions.description: Number of passed/failed tests is displayed
assertions.check: output contains test count like '13 passed'

assertions.name: no_immediate_failure
assertions.description: Skill does not stop on first failure (since all tests pass)
assertions.check: output shows complete test run, not truncated
